about: X8: the bundled program_checks.py on checks-okuma.MIN with its form defaults, no machine chosen. The whole report; every row with a line jumps to it.

report.title: Program checks

rows.message: O6301 G50: the program name has to stand in a block of its own
N100G00: the sequence name has to be followed by a space or a tab

the unit system decides every value, written with a point or without: X600000: read as 600000 mm by 'Unit 1 mm' (the assumed default), 600 mm by 'Unit 1 µm' or 6000 mm by 'Unit 10 µm, metric only'; choose a machine
G96: constant surface speed with no spindle speed clamp before it; the spindle speeds up as the diameter shrinks
G96: the block has to write S
G140: the control refuses it while constant surface speed is on
T0303: a 4-digit tool word after 6-digit ones (line 9); one file should keep to one form
G33 X59400 Z-30000 F2000: a thread cut under constant surface speed; the speed changes with the diameter and the lead may not follow
G01 X60000 F200: a cut while the spindle is stopped (M05 on line 27)
G97 S500 M03 S600: 2 S words in one block
M110: has to stand in a block of its own; the block writes M05 besides it
T001212: a tool change while the cycle G181 (line 40) is in force
M03 M08 M10 M11 M24 M25 M41 M42 M73: 9 M codes in one block; the control takes at most 8
GOTO NEND2: no block NEND2 in this program
(RETRACT, THE COMMENT IS NOT CLOSED: the comment is opened with ( and not closed with ) on its line
VC1=[VC2+1: 1 [ is not closed
g00, z400000: written in lower case; this control reads its addresses in upper case
–: – (en dash) is not an ASCII character, outside a comment
M00: Program stop
M01: Optional stop
G00 X600000: after the program end M02 on line 59; it never runs

report.message: 21 findings in 19 checks. No machine chosen: where the presets read a number differently, the finding lists every reading.
